notes: As of 2026-11-13. Prices are delayed quotes from massive.com / stockanalysis.com snapshots; each latest_price carries its own as_of date, several are 1-2 weeks old, and some are intraday. Returns computed vs offer price (ex-greenshoe). Pricing dates inferred as the evening before first trade where sources gave only the trading date (APMD, VOGX, RTSN). Seaport and Hemab priced 2026-04-30 and first traded 2026-05-01; included as boundary cases. Gross proceeds are base deal sizes excluding overallotment; Odyssey had a further $25M placement, Windward a $50M placement (Fierce reported $225M total). COAG price ($41.18) and ETRA price ($9.03) came from garbled quote pages, low confidence. Lockup expiry not found in public sources (null); typical 180 days. Windward debuted 2026-11-13 so no trading data yet. Rezera and vVardis were scheduled the week of 11/9 and no pricing was found; they may have priced 11/12-11/13. vVardis is a dental/OTC-peptide company, borderline specialty pharma. Excluded: Mobia Medical (device), RegenLab USA (device, $6-8 range, RGNA), SPACs, EIR Biopharma (stale NYSE micro-cap filing, no status found), Corxel (SPAC merger). Avalyn and Eikon priced before May. Backers listed only where sources named them.
